Let a distinguished one-handle persist from a cancelling $1/2$ birth to a cancelling $1/2$ death, with no one-handle slides involving it on the interval. All feet, actual framed two-handle attaching strips, slide bands, local birth/death supports and outgoing identifications are supplied. Choose a framed replacement arc in $N$ joining its feet and carry it by the foot isotopy; assume other birth/death supports miss its tube. Replacing the one-handle by interior surgery on its core joined to that arc, then cancelling the long two-handle, gives a based framed-link movie. Its changes are framed isotopy, $O2$ band slides (including a meridian slide when a strip crosses the replacement arc), and $O3$ at its two endpoints. Here $O3$ is a framed knot with its small disk-zero meridian. All framings and actual outgoing boundary maps are retained, and the boundary collar is fixed pointwise. The statement permits arbitrary homotopy class of the replacement arc and arbitrary finite signed traversals by the other strips. It is local conversion of the supplied movie, not its global existence.

Suppose two all-two-handle presentations are joined by a finite index-grouped mixed-handle movie on W: elementary framed attaching maps vary smoothly between events; events are cancelling births/deaths 0/1,1/2,2/3,3/4, same-index handle slides and critical-value interchanges of disjoint attachments. All terminal maps are retained. Positive-index-drop trajectory tangencies are permitted, since the elementary-band attaching maps remain smooth through them. The one-handle slide after trading is [[lem-one-handle-slides-become-relative-kirby-slides-after-trading]].
